brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team.

slots.title: 1. Claude Code, the engineer
slots.body: Claude Code handles full-stack coding, debugging, and refactors in your terminal. It writes tests, explains legacy code, and ships features while you focus on product decisions.

slots.title: 2. Next.js, the foundation
slots.body: App Router, Server Actions, and Vercel deployment mean zero-config hosting. One codebase handles SSR, API routes, and edge functions without DevOps overhead.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Postgres database, auth, and storage with instant APIs. Row-level security and real-time subscriptions replace a backend team from day one.

slots.title: 4. Stripe, the finance team
slots.body: Billing, subscriptions, and invoicing wrapped in prebuilt components. Webhooks sync payments to your database while you sleep.

slots.title: 5. Figma, the design studio
slots.body: Design, prototype, and hand off responsive components directly to code. Claude reads exported assets and builds pixel-perfect UI in minutes.

slots.title: 6. Linear, the project manager
slots.body: Issue tracking and roadmaps that stay in sync with GitHub. Cycles keep shipping velocity high without standups or sprint planning.

slots.headline: Build Your Solo Stack
slots.subline: Copy this setup, cut your build time in half, and launch before your competition hires their first engineer.
